states_and_actions: Wide entry: select worktreeA; inspect existing Files/Source control/Pull request/Details, open palette and new Search shortcut/tab, ensure query focus. Confirm old Search projects and pane Find still act independently; edit, unbind and restore only new shortcut.
Empty/no-root/remote: blank query help, choose-worktree notice and local-only remote notice; no misleading completed-result or active-worktree identity.

Populated/streaming: type tokenA, observe incremental results and completion in A; switch toB during an unfinished A query, retain query/options, require B-only results and original stale A Batch/Error/Finished refusal. Ordinary updates/other-root events must not repeatedly restart or steal focus.

Options/filtering: exercise case/whole-word/regex, include/exclude and ignored/hidden individually and in combinations; invalid regex/glob and corrected query, genuine zero matches, skipped-file notice, over2000 cap/refinement. Verify labels/counts agree with fixture and no hidden option changed.

Results/ordering: at more than100 matches, Previous/Next, keyboard Up/Down across page boundaries/wrap and Enter, pointer activation, scrolling and same-generation streamed append; no row/index retargeting. Check long paths and Unicode/long snippets retain usable file identity and visible hit at both widths.

Open: existing/new repository card, cached/deferred read, exact UTF8 native match selection, stale file changed between scan/click/load with visible reload warning, normal reopen clears stale warning. Dirty/save/pending editor remains protected and keeps content/history. Verify accepted open focus and old LSP/completion refusal without overwriting unsaved text.

Narrow overlay: open Search from keyboard/tab, filter/result scroll/next page, activate result, overlay closes and editor is visible/focused. Reopen Search, resize docked↔overlay/free-edge/maximized and check focus, full-height results and reachable controls.

Error/recovery: leave selected root missing beyond debounce, observe current folder error plus visible Retry; restore validB at same logical key, activate Retry without editing query/options, require freshB result and completion. Neighbor activity/responsiveness: busy agents/terminals while searching, hover/scroll/type/resize and active-window loss/regain.
